title: Implement the VCF Operations for Logs asynchronous cluster join client
prompt:
Implement the VCF Operations for Logs 9.0 asynchronous cluster-join client in this Go module. The bundled specifications/vcf-operations/vcf-operations-for-logs-openapi.json is a focused, frozen extract of the official vmware/vcf-api-specs OpenAPI file at tag 9.0.0.0; use it as the sole API contract, not a documentation page and not the 9.1 Log Management revision.

Create docs/contract.json so that it is JSON-equivalent to the bundled focused OpenAPI extract, which contains exactly the operations POST_deployment-join and POST_deployment-waitUntilStarted. Create docs/official_sources.json with the keys repository, license, spec_path, tag, commit_sha, and operation_ids, recording repository vmware/vcf-api-specs, license Apache-2.0, spec path specifications/vcf-operations/vcf-operations-for-logs-openapi.json, tag 9.0.0.0, commit 85151f6b1bb58f13b6ac0304bfec53904bea085f, and both operationIds.

At the module root, package vcflogs must expose JoinRequest with MasterFQDN string plus optional *int MasterPort and *bool AcceptCert fields; JoinResponse with MasterAddress string, WorkerAddress string, WorkerPort int, WorkerToken string, and MasterUIPort int; NewClient(endpoint string, httpClient *http.Client) (*Client, error); and (*Client).JoinAndWait(ctx context.Context, request JoinRequest, pollInterval time.Duration) (JoinResponse, error). JoinAndWait must POST the join once, then POST waitUntilStarted until its terminal HTTP 200 response. A wait HTTP 500 is the contract's retryable nonterminal result; wait for pollInterval and poll again. A non-2xx response other than that retryable wait result is an error, and context cancellation must stop waiting. There is no attempt limit. Send the exact /api/v2 paths with no query string. The join body is JSON and unset optional fields must be absent, while explicitly supplied false must remain present. The polling request has no body.

Also implement package mocklogs as a loopback httptest server pinned to docs/contract.json. It must expose New(waitStatuses ...int) (*Server, error), URL() string, Client() *http.Client, Close(), and Requests() []RequestLog. RequestLog must expose Method string, RequestURI string, Header http.Header, Body []byte, and ContentLength int64. The waitStatuses arguments script successive polling responses; with no arguments the server returns 200, and after a script is exhausted its last status repeats. New must reject statuses other than the contract's 200 and 500 wait responses. The server may serve only the two named operations and must return 404 for every other path or method. Its request log must be safe to snapshot while requests are being served, including by returning snapshots that callers cannot use to mutate the server's stored log.

Add table-driven tests for minimal, populated, and explicitly-false optional request fields and for polling behavior. No test may contact a live VMware endpoint. go test -race ./... is the acceptance command.
